changed_after_observed_failure.statement: This check was changed after an observed failure. I16-1 failed only the core check 'Q1 |I(V(d,s) = 0)| <= 1e-12 A, default and tight' (1.0006e-12 A at 1 of 2700 points: pmos_L8_W0p84, |V(g,s)| 0.825 V, default tolerance). The I16-1 outcome stays recorded as 'not deployable'.
changed_after_observed_failure.known_before_registration: The post hoc diagnosis I16_1/diagnosis/vds0.json gives the tight-tolerance values of the I16-1 run: element max 4.87e-17 A over 18 devices (0 of 1350 points above 1e-12 A); card + replica max 4.66e-17 A. A rerun with the same model and procedure is expected to reproduce these values; the I17-1 outcome for this check is therefore not a test that was blind to the data.

changed_check.I16_1: Q1 |I(V(d,s) = 0)| <= 1e-12 A at default tolerance (ngspice defaults: abstol 1e-12 A, reltol 1e-3) and at tight tolerance (reltol 1e-9, abstol 1e-18 A, vntol 1e-12 V); max over both
changed_check.I17_1: Q1 |I(V(d,s) = 0)| <= 1e-12 A at tight tolerance only (reltol 1e-9, abstol 1e-18 A, vntol 1e-12 V), forward Q1 grids of the 18 devices
changed_check.option_chosen: tight tolerance only (not an abstol-derived threshold)
justification: At default tolerance ngspice accepts a Newton iterate when the change of each branch current is within reltol |I| + abstol; abstol is 1e-12 A, equal to the threshold. A value of order 1e-12 A at V(d,s) = 0 is within the accepted solver error, so a check at that tolerance with that threshold does not separate a model current from the solver tolerance.

An abstol-derived threshold (k x abstol at default tolerance) requires a choice of k that is not given by the solver documentation; any k chosen now would be chosen with the observed 1.0006e-12 A known.
At tight tolerance abstol is 1e-18 A, six orders of magnitude below the unchanged threshold 1e-12 A; an element current of 1e-12 A at V(d,s) = 0 would be detected. The threshold value is kept.
The default-tolerance value is reported (per device, no rule) and stays visible next to the decision.
changed_check.reported_without_rule: max |I(V(d,s) = 0)| at default and r4 tolerance per device and the number of points above 1e-12 A (as I16_1/diagnosis/vds0.json)
changed_check.computation: max over the 18 devices of |I| of the element run at the V(d,s) = 0 column of the forward tight Q1 grid (75 V(g,s) values per device, 1350 points), from the I17-1 arrays

outputs: out/research/explore/I17_1/{validity, accuracy, deploy_sel, decision.json}; arrays (*.npz) and OSDI binaries not in git
